draft.shortGloss: to forget; to be unable to recall
draft.emotion: a slightly apologetic or frustrated sigh, acknowledging a lapse in memory
notes: 잊다 (it-da) means to forget something that was previously known or stored in memory.
Be careful not to confuse this with 잃어버리다 (il-eo-beo-ri-da), which means 'to lose' an object physically. You 'forget' a name, but you 'lose' your wallet.

senses.definition: To not remember or be unable to recall information or a fact.
